data.gender_notes: Zadie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Zadok, meaning 'justice of God'. In the Bible, Zadok was a priest who served in the temple of Solomon. Zadie is a feminine variant and carries the same divine connotation, symbolizing a little one loved by God. The name Zadie carries the meaning “Little One of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zadie usually hope their child will grow to embody little one of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's love and divine protection.
data.etymology: Zadie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little One of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zadie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: זאדיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם זאדיה הוא עברי ומשמעותו 'זרוע ה' היא גבורה רוחנית', קשור לנושאים של חוזק וסמכות רוחניים. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'זרוע' שפירושה זרוע או כוח, ו-'ה'' שפירושו אלוהים. השם מופיע בהקשרים שונים בכתבי הקודש העבריים, ומשקף את הנושאים של כוח אלוהי והגבורה הרוחנית.

in_greek.name: Ζαδίη
in_greek.meaning: Τὸ κυρίοὐ βραχίων ἐστὶ πνευματικὴ δύναμις
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Ζαδίη εἰς τὴν ἑβραϊκὴν γλώσσαν ἀναφέρεται εἰς τὴν ἰσχύν καὶ ἐξουσίαν πνευματικήν. Σύνθετον ὄνομα παρὰ τῶν λέξεων 'זרוע' (βραχίων) καὶ 'ה'' (τοῦ κυρίου), σημαίνων τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ θεοῦ. Ἐν τοῖς χριστιανικοῖς κειμένους, ὁ Ζαδίη ἀπεικονίζει τὴν πνευματικὴν ἰσχύν καὶ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς θείας ἐπιρροῆς.

in_latin.name: Zadie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zadie originem habet hebraicam, significans 'Domini brachium est virtus spiritualis'. Compositum est ex duobus vocabulis: 'זרוע' (brachium) et 'ה'' (Domini), denotans potentiam et auctoritatem spiritualem. In traditione christiana, Zadie refert ad themes de fortitudine et potestate divina.

in_english.name: Zadie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zadie originates from Hebrew roots, signifying 'God's arm' or 'spiritual strength'. It combines 'זרוע' (arm or strength) and 'ה'' (God), reflecting themes of divine power and spiritual fortitude. In Christian tradition, Zadie embodies the concept of spiritual strength and divine support. Historically, the name may relate to biblical concepts of God's providence and protection. The personality traits associated with Zadie include courage, resilience, and faithfulness. Modern usage of the name Zadie varies across Christian cultures, symbolizing a connection to spiritual heritage.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Zadie: God's remembrance or God's grace in abundance. This name is derived from the Hebrew name "Sadie" which means princess or noblewoman, but in Christianity, it takes on the meaning of God's constant reminder and abundant grace.

historical_references.reference: Zadie is a variant of the name Sadie, which originated in the 19th century as a diminutive form of Sadie.
historical_references.context: The name Zadie is often associated with the Victorian era and the tradition of using diminutive forms of names.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Zadie remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Zadie from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Zadie - "Little One of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
